0022600218.text: The Cavaliers (5-6) enter on a two-game losing streak, sitting 2nd in the Central, 2.5 games back, and 7th in the East, with a 1-4 road record. The Knicks (5-4) are on a three-game winning streak, 3-2 at home and 5th in the East, and in 2025-26 the Cavaliers lost their season series 1-2 and were swept 0-4 in the playoffs. Cleveland trails 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 109-97 loss in Cleveland on November 7, and Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow) are both out for the Cavaliers.
